C0407.title: Uber and Cisco Breaches via Push Bombing
C0407.summary: Push bombing, also known as MFA fatigue, has been exploited in high-profile breaches at Uber and Cisco. Attackers, including the ransomware group Scattered Spider, leverage this technique to bypass multi-factor authentication by overwhelming users with repeated push notifications until they approve one, granting unauthorized access.

references.title: What Is Push Bombing? And How Beyond Identity Makes It Impossible
